abstract: Third-generation sequencing enables direct detection of genome-wide 5-methylcytosine without bisulfite conversion. Here, we present a protocol for generating long-read DNA sequencing from mouse cortex and performing genome-wide differential methylation analysis. We describe steps for high-molecular-weight DNA extraction, data generation, and downstream analysis. We demonstrate the workflow in the AppNL-G-F mouse model of amyloid pathology and provide a reproducible pipeline that links modified-base BAM (modBAM) files to annotated differentially methylated regions and functional enrichment results.
